But then it passes those physical indices to `islice` over `self` (which iterates over visible items only, skipping dead ones). This mixes physical storage offsets with visible item positions.

The fix: slicing should depend on visible ordered contents. So `iter_slice` should work with visible positions directly, not convert to real indices.
